mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, bool_status_enum, name, serial_number, specification, length, material, quantity, net_weight, total_net_weight, gross_weight, total_gross_weight, surface_area, use_property, auxiliary_class_id, machine_part_id, remark
mapper.select:
SELECT
ap.project_id 'project.id', cp.name 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.short_name', cp.serial_number 'project.serial_number',
ap.monomer_id 'monomer.id', m.name 'monomer.name',
ap.area_id 'area.id', a.name 'area.name',
ap.auxiliary_class_id, ac.`name`, ap.specification, ap.material, ap.length, ap.remark, SUM(ap.quantity) quantity FROM `tech_auxiliary_part` ap INNER JOIN sys_auxiliary_classification ac ON ap.auxiliary_class_id = ac.id AND ac.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN contract_project cp on ap.project_id = cp.id and cp.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN plan_monomer m on ap.monomer_id = m.id and m.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN plan_area a on ap.area_id = a.id and a.bool_delete_enum = 0
WHERE ap.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND ap.project_id = #{projectId}
AND ap.monomer_id = #{monomerId}
AND ap.area_id = #{areaId}
GROUP BY
ap.project_id,
ap.monomer_id ,
ap.area_id ,
ap.auxiliary_class_id, ap.specification, ap.material, ap.length, ap.remark
